# What the AppImage builds with, on Ubuntu 24.04. GDAL is left out on purpose: it pulls in a large tree of
# libraries, Ubuntu's own older Poppler among them.
# Build tools and required libraries
cmake
g++
pkg-config
file
wget
qt6-base-dev
qt6-svg-dev
qt6-base-dev-tools
qt6-wayland
qmake6
zlib1g-dev
libharfbuzz-dev
libgl1-mesa-dev
libopengl0
# For the self-test's text layout and hyphenation
fonts-dejavu-core
fonts-liberation
hyphen-en-us
# Linked format libraries
libcdr-dev
librevenge-dev
libwpg-dev
libvisio-dev
libfreehand-dev
libmspub-dev
libpagemaker-dev
libzmf-dev
libqxp-dev
libstaroffice-dev
libetonyek-dev
libmwaw-dev
libjxr-dev
libzstd-dev
libgdcm-dev
libwmf-dev
libopenslide-dev
libgraphviz-dev
# Poppler's build
libfreetype-dev
libfontconfig-dev
libjpeg-dev
libpng-dev
libtiff-dev
libopenjp2-7-dev
liblcms2-dev
# Loaded at runtime when present; the AppImage bundles them
liblcms2-2
libraw23t64
libopenjp2-7
libjxl0.7
libdjvulibre21
libjbig2dec0
libqrencode4
libarchive13t64
libmobi0
# Qt's xcb platform plugin needs these on the build machine to bundle them
libxcb-cursor0
